priceSnapshot.note: Midday closed the handover at 86,621.5. Six hours and forty-two minutes later spot is 86,482.4, down 139.1 points or 0.16 percent on the handover, but up 0.24 percent on the rolling 24h open of 86,275.8. The short squeeze midday flagged kept running for another two-plus hours after the report published: this window's realized OKX liquidations are 822,291.77 USD of shorts against just 30,679.69 USD of longs, a 26.8-to-1 ratio, even more lopsided than midday's 12.0-to-1 print, and it carried price to a fresh session high of 86,652.0 before fading back under 86,500. The single most important fact in this file is that momentum decelerated hard while the squeeze was still running: 4H MACD histogram fell from plus 252.28 at midday to plus 76.21 now, a 70 percent collapse, even though 4H RSI barely moved (76.56 to 75.51). That is a classic tell that a move is losing its own fuel, not that it has reversed. The 86,632.6 continuation add gate has still NOT fired on a settled 1H close - the highest settled close since midday is 86,458.2, 174.4 points short - so the desk has now watched that exact gate hold for three consecutive sessions without a single settled breach.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below 85,325.2, unchanged for a fourth consecutive report. The session low since midday was 86,001.8, some 676.6 points clear of this gate - it was not remotely threatened, so there is still no reason to move a level the market has not argued with.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close above 86,632.6, unchanged for a third consecutive report. The squeeze pushed a session high of 86,652.0 - through the level on a wick - but the highest SETTLED 1H close since midday was 86,458.2, 174.4 points short. Wick is not a close; the level has now survived three straight sessions untouched on a settled basis even as price traded through it intrasession twice (once at midday, once this session).

decisionBox.changed: Position flips from ADD to TAKE_PROFIT for the overnight gap, and the trade is a small defensive trim rather than a top call. Three measurable facts changed since midday, and per this desk's own standing lesson - grade a decision by the class of evidence behind it, not the direction - all three are the structural kind that is allowed to trigger action, not the oscillator kind that only sizes it. FIRST, 4H MACD histogram collapsed 70 percent (252.28 to 76.21) while price barely moved, meaning the buying that drove the squeeze is running out even though RSI has not confirmed a turn yet - momentum decays before price does. SECOND, open interest FELL 0.44 percent (2,642,096,203 to 2,630,402,092 USD) while price was flat to slightly down, the same open-interest-divergence pattern the 21 September endday lesson used to justify its own trim: the perpetual's buyer of last resort is stepping back, not adding. THIRD, the Fear and Greed Index dropped from 78 Extreme Greed to 71 Greed, a seven-point one-day retreat from the sentiment extreme. None of these fire the reduce gate and none invalidate the uptrend - price is still above every EMA on all four timeframes and the L/S account ratio is still pinned net-short at 0.94, unchanged from midday, so upside fuel has not been exhausted. But the next report is roughly nine and a half hours away at 02:00 COT, the longest unprotected window of the day, and a defensive trim raises cash for tomorrow while the core position keeps running. This session sells a small slice of spot, sized deliberately smaller than 21 September's 10 percent trim because the structural evidence this time is milder. The invalidation level trails up from the stale 84,719.5 (last tested 21 September) to 85,111.1, today's actual tested low from the overnight wick - a level the market HAS argued with, unlike the old one. The resting stop sits just under it at 85,050.0. Reduce and add gates are unchanged; both have now gone three-plus sessions without a settled-close test.

overnightRisk: Next report is roughly nine hours and twenty minutes away at approximately 02:00 COT - the longest unprotected window of the day. Spot is consolidating 169.6 points under today's 86,652.0 high with 4H momentum decelerating hard (MACD histogram down 70 percent from midday) even as RSI holds at 75.51, and Fear and Greed has cooled from Extreme Greed 78 to Greed 71 in a single day. Open interest fell 0.44 percent while price stalled, consistent with position unwind rather than fresh demand. A specific data gap matters here: the OKX realized-liquidation feed's 100-fill cap only reaches back to a lowest fill of 85,948.4 this run, meaning the fills that actually drove price up to the 86,652.0 high are already outside the visible window - there is no verified liquidation magnet above current spot, only the unconfirmed 24h high at 86,731.0 and the 87,399.0 eight-month cycle high further out. Catalysts to watch through the gap: the Asian cash session (roughly 00:00-09:00 UTC, thinnest liquidity of the day), any follow-through commentary on the 22 September ETF print (plus 364.4 million USD, a fourth straight positive day but smaller than 21 September's plus 999.0 million, confirmed only after today's US close), and whether Brent's fifth straight down day on Iran de-escalation headlines feeds into risk appetite. The resting stop at 85,050.0, just under the trailed invalidation of 85,111.1 (today's actual tested overnight low), is the only mechanical protection in place given the futures book is flat and cannot be stopped out on its own; a low-liquidity air-pocket move through it before Asia opens is the scenario this stop exists for.

What IS verified is the dominant 86,250.0 shelf below spot, where 615,936.57 USD already discharged on the way up - fuel that has been spent, not fuel that is waiting. Positioning still leans bullish for the next move: L/S account ratio is flat at 0.94 across the last four hourly buckets, unchanged from midday, and funding is still at the floor at 0.0000222, so accounts remain net short into a rally with no leverage cost - but that is a reason to expect potential energy, not a measured magnet, which is why pull is not called up.
